chunks: "When al-Husayn ibn 'Ali عليه السلام was killed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded an angel, and he proclaimed: O oppressive nation, killer of the progeny of its Prophet, may Allah, Exalted is He, not grant you success in fasting nor in breaking the fast."

key_terms.الظَّالِمَةُ: oppressive or wrongdoing, describing the nation being condemned
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنُ: al-Husayn, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and central figure of the martyrdom being described
key_terms.صَوْمٍ: fasting, the act of religious abstention mentioned in the proclamation
key_terms.عِتْرَةَ: the progeny or purified family line of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فِطْرٍ: breaking the fast, referring to iftar or completion of the fast

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say happened after the martyrdom of al-Husayn ibn 'Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a divine proclamation after the killing of al-Husayn ibn 'Ali عليه السلام, condemning the ummah for slaying the Prophet’s progeny. It presents the tragedy of Karbala as a moment of immense moral and spiritual consequence, linked here to the withholding of divine tawfiq even in acts related to fasting.
